title: Kenyan Saffron Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and aromatic rice bowl dish inspired by Kenyan cuisine, featuring saffron-infused rice and a hint of spices.
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine-mesh sieve until the water runs clear.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rice and 2 cups of water.
Add the soaked saffron and its liquid to the saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced hash and cook until golden brown, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Stir in the aromatic spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in the cooked hash mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
